class.name: HTMLPointerEvent
class.brief_description: A pointer event for mouse and touch input.
class.description: Pointer events report a stable pointer ID and a type of [code]mouse[/code], [code]pen[/code], or [code]touch[/code]. Pointer events are dispatched alongside compatible mouse events when applicable.

members.member: The ID for this pointer. Mouse events use [code]0[/code].
Whether this is the primary pointer of its type.
